title: ssize_t to int cast truncation in generate_eui64 log
description:
Location: firmware/bridge-zephyr/subsys/lichen/lora_l2.c:111,133

hwid_len is ssize_t but is cast to int for logging:
- Line 111: LOG_ERR("hwinfo returned invalid length: %d", (int)hwid_len)
- Line 133: LOG_DBG("EUI-64 from hashed hardware ID (%d bytes)", (int)hwid_len)

What goes wrong: ssize_t can be 64-bit on some platforms while int is 32-bit. Values > INT_MAX would wrap, displaying incorrect values in logs. The actual hwid_len is bounded by sizeof(hwid)=32, so no actual bug here, but the pattern is incorrect.

Fix: Use %zd format specifier with (ssize_t)hwid_len or cast to (long) with %ld for maximum portability.
close_reason: Fixed all six ssize_t log casts across both trees holding generate_eui64: bead's named path firmware/bridge-zephyr/subsys/lichen/lora_l2.c (lines had shifted to 283,299,342) and its current canonical counterpart after the module split lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lora_l2_identity.c (102,119,162). Used %ld with (long)hwid_len per the bead's maximum-portability option; removed the now-false cast-to-int justification comments. Kept ret=(int)hwid_len return cast (int errno return, in-range by definition). clang -fsyntax-only not feasible on this macOS host: no local Zephyr tree/include paths (verified: fails at zephyr/net headers); per AGENTS.md Zephyr builds run on EC2.
